differs.mechanic: A jacquard: hooks lift the warp threads by a bitmap of the product's name, so the cloth weaves a figure instead of a plain twill, and the loom slows as the name comes into view.
differs.layout: Hero scale: one short headline across the top and a full-width loom whose cloth fills the frame, instead of copy on the left and a loom in the right half.
differs.moment: The whole product name stands legible in the woven cloth, its letters made of the tools' coloured threads.

blurb: A jacquard loom lifts each tool's warp threads by a bitmap, so your product's name is woven into the cloth from their colours.
